title: Sharing local history with schools; island churches; parents' births and immigration
description: Elsie Nelson describes how her books are used in Moscow high school history classes and how she now has students visit her home to ask questions, as well as recording work for the museum. She recounts telling students about the churches on her father's home island and her 1953 visit there, then gives her mother Mary Lynd's 1873 birth and her father's 1859 birth, and the family's emigration to Minnesota. She also touches on the family's Lutheran background and her mother's Presbyterian Sunday school attendance.
